Exhaustive coverage is a full mutation census of the caller's artefact (85 sites / ~42 min for muneral) and is refused for cost, stated with the arithmetic, never as a solved problem; whether the declared verifier job is REQUIRED in branch protection: B6.6 reads the caller's `verifier_job` / `verifier_conclusion` workflow inputs (gate2a's, unchanged) and proves the named job succeeded on this head — not that GitHub would block a merge without it; a declared path the graph builder does not model: it has no dependents and satisfies B6.3's impact bound VACUOUSLY. That is A4's coverage gap inherited by the declaration, reported through C17 as not_measured, never as a pass; a head workflow rewritten so that it never invokes the gate at all, or invokes it and reports success regardless: no arm of any battery runs to contradict a job that did not run. B8 refuses the pull request that edits the vendored workflow and verify_bundle refuses the next run, but the required status check is satisfied by a job matching the check's NAME. That residual is closed by branch protection in the caller, measured as required in ONE of four callers on 2026-09-24 (DEC-AUP-0036 card C3), and by nothing in this contract.; whether the bytes a bundle ships stand at the program commit it names: B5 remains not_measured and is NOT in the eligibility conjunction. DEC-AUP-0036 R1 now binds the PRODUCER (built from the git object store at program_ref, refusing a dirty tree with BUNDLE_SOURCE_NOT_AT_REF and writing no signature) and R2 records each file's git blob OID so a caller can CONTRADICT the claim offline with git hash-object. Neither makes B5 a verdict — R3's B5a split is a later card, and until it lands the provenance claim is falsifiable but unenforced.
